title: Bayonne Lion:
title_short: Bayonne Lion · We Have So Many
headline: A Lion who lives with blindness and hearing loss says the hard part is picking just one Lion who feels like family.
story: Stephen is asked which Lion became like family. He laughs: that's the hard one, because we have so many. His club in Bayonne, New Jersey is a very close family. Then we learn his story. He has Usher syndrome, an eye disease that causes blindness and hearing loss. In a big crowd he needs his cane. His club backs his own nonprofit, Spoken Heroes.

The last quarter ties it back: millions of people all over the world who love to build community and connection, and that keeps the heart warm. Light, warm, proud. His condition is a fact in his story, never the sad part.
